name: Lupin Ltd.
business_summary: Mumbai-based global generics and speciality pharma company: US ~38%, India ~32% (branded, strong in respiratory, cardio, anti-diabetic), Rest of World/EM and South Africa ~15%, Europe/Canada ~8%, API ~5% (model knowledge, verify). Q2 FY27 (2026-11-03): revenue Rs 7,827 cr (+11% to +14% YoY), net profit Rs 1,155 cr (-22%) after an exceptional antitrust (US generic-pricing litigation) charge; margins compressed on US competition and portfolio investment; management expects lower operating margins in FY28 (Sahi 2026-11-05). Data caution: the screener pack's quarterly sales/OPM (e.g. Jun-26 sales Rs 7,172 cr at 52% OPM, Sep-26 Rs 3,567 cr) are internally inconsistent with press-reported revenue and are not used for margins. Mcap Rs 90,258 cr, stock -17% in 3m.

revenue_mix.segment: Rest of World and emerging markets

exposures.mechanism: US ~38% of sales (Rs ~3,000 cr/qtr at Q2 revenue Rs 7,827 cr). Management/analysts cite US competition as the margin driver (Jefferies cut TP 15%, NDTV Profit 2026-11-05). +5pp erosion on ~70% of base = -3.5% US = -1.3% group sales; ~100% drop-through at assumed ~25% OPM = -5.3% EBITDA; EV/MCap 1.03; persistence 0.5 -> -2.7; plus competition on key limited-competition products (inhalers, injectables) and guided FY28 margin decline -> -5.0.

evidence.note: Lupin Q2: US competition pressured margins (TradingView 2026-11-04); Jefferies cuts target 15% (NDTV Profit 2026-11-05)

exposures.mechanism: Large US exposure from Pithampur, Goa, Nagpur, Somerset and Coral Springs plants (model knowledge, Pithampur/ Somerset had earlier warning letters). New launches (Oct: Vitamin K injection approval; inhalers) depend on clean inspections. OAI probability 20% x -14% equity + delay noise -> -3.0.

evidence.note: US FDA nod for Vitamin K injection (Equitypandit 2026-10-09)

exposures.mechanism: US tariffs of 100% on branded drugs began 2026-09-29, India and 19 others exempt for speciality; generics outside. Lupin also manufactures at Coral Springs (Florida), Somerset (NJ) - partial US footprint reduces risk (~25% of US sales US-made, model knowledge). 10% probability of generic tariff: -9% equity if imposed -> -0.9.

evidence.note: US exempts India's speciality drugs from 100% tariff (Business Standard, Firstpost 2026-09-29)

exposures.mechanism: USD-linked sales ~60% (US 38% + EM/others 22% USD-ish), imports ~10% of sales: net 50% x 3% = +1.5% of sales; at ~25% OPM +6% EBITDA; 40% hedged -> +3.6%; EV/MCap 1.03, persistence 0.5 -> +1.9; plus EM dollarised sales -> +3.0. Empirical +1.83 (t=1.4) lower.

China-origin APIs/KSMs a material share of inputs (model: ~20% of RM, RM ~30% of costs). +15% price cuts -> RM -3% -> costs -0.9% -> EBITDA +4% at 25% OPM, half competed away -> +2% x 1.03 x 0.3 persistence = +0.6; rounded +0.7.

evidence.note: Margin pressure from costs and competition in Q2 (Investing.com 2026-11-04)

exposures.mechanism: India branded business ~32% of sales growing faster than market (management, CNBC TV18 2026-08-07). +5pp urban consumption lifts India growth ~1.2pp = +0.4% group sales; ~60% flow-through at ~25% OPM = +1.0% EBITDA; persistence 0.5-1.0 with multiple effect -> +1.2.

evidence.note: Lupin sees stronger FY27 US sales, India growth to outpace market (CNBC TV18 2026-08-07)

exposures.mechanism: Almost debt free (interest Rs 33 cr/qtr); discount-rate effect on a 16x TTM P/E (value stock) -> -0.5 per +25bp.

evidence.note: Interest Rs 32.6 cr in Sep-26 quarter (screener.in)

exposures.mechanism: Freight/solvent cost and South Africa/Middle East supply lanes (RoW ~15%); +10% logistics = +0.4% costs -> EBITDA -1.5%; persistence 0.25, EV/MCap 1.03 -> -0.4; rounded -0.7 with EM demand risk.
FII holding rising: 21.7% -> 23.3% over two quarters; beta 0.55-0.67 (low). +US$5bn -> +0.8 beyond beta.

supply_chain.counterparty: Indian generics peers (Cipla, DRL, Sun, Zydus, Aurobindo)

company_events.event: US launch of generic HIV drug with 180-day exclusivity eligibility (announced 2026-11-03)
Q3 FY27 results: US competition, margin trajectory vs FY28 guidance of lower margins
Quantification/resolution of antitrust settlement and cash outflow
Inhaler (Spiriva/ Advair generic) approvals and US limited-competition launches
